svg.desc: Android application workflow | Based on the current source code | Authentication, navigation, monitoring and control
svg.text: Android application workflow | Based on the current source code | Authentication, navigation, monitoring and control
readings, pump state and filter health
User toggles Pump A or B;
H = return to Home / main navigation. L = return to Login. Diamonds = decisions; slanted boxes = displayed data.
App boundary: Firebase carries commands and telemetry. Controller automation and physical filtration belong in Flowchart 02.
Filter life uses measured runtime and sensor data with a model trained on generated data. Missing measurements show a waiting state.
